name: Sika Dilatec BR-500
paste:
SIKA® DILATEC® BR-500: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Dilatec® BR-500, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika-dilatec-br-500.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Dilatec® BR-500 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Dilatec® BR-500 is a flexible waterproofing tape based on polyvinyl chloride (PVC) with advanced adhesion properties. The tape terminates and connects bituminous waterproofing membranes to Sikaplan® WP (PVC) sheet membranes. The B-edge on one side is bonded to the bituminous membranes with hot-melt bitumen. The R-edge on the other side is hot air welded to the Sikaplan® WP membranes. Thickness 1,6 mm. Part of the Sika® Dilatec® joint sealing system.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sealing of different structures and applications including:
    - Bridges
    - Basements
    - Cut and cover tunnels
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Sealing of.
    - Connections between adjoining bituminous and PVC waterproofing membranes
    - Construction joints
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Dilatec® BR-500
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PVC multifunctional sealing tape for PVC and bitumuminous membranes
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Elongation, Tensile Strength, Foldability, Puncture and Tear Resistance tests, Sika® Dilatec® BR-500, tecnotest ag, Test report No. A4447-01
    - Fire Testing EN ISO 11925, Sika® Dilatec® BR-500, tecnotest ag, Test report No. A4020-08
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN ISO 11925: listed under approvals, certificates or standards; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - SN EN 12691: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to impact (p.2).
    - EN ISO 527-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN ISO 527-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation (p.2).
    - DIN 16 726: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Seam strength (p.2); Technical Information > Tear strength (p.2).
    - SN EN 495-5: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Foldability at low temperature (p.2).
    - EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Chemical resistance (p.2); Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
    - EN 1847: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Chemical resistance (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Multifunctional solution for sealing bituminous membrane to PVC membrane
    - Good adhesion properties
    - No activation on site required
    - High flexibility and joint bridging ability
    - Good chemical resistance
    - Resistant to weathering
    - Root penetration resistant
    - Hot air weldable
    - Adaptable to many different jointing situations
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: PVC, bitumen compatible (PVC-P-BV)
    - Appearance and colour: Tape with glass fibre reinforcement and fabric edging strip. Top surface is light grey, bottom surface is black.
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Width: 500 mm
    - Resistance to impact: ≥ 650 mm (SN EN 12691, method A)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Tensile strength: > 6,5 N/mm² (EN ISO 527-3)
    - Elongation: > 200 % (EN ISO 527-1)
    - Tear strength: Weld seam strength; Failure always adjacent to seam (DIN 16 726)
    - Seam strength: Weld seam strength: Failure always adjacent to seam (DIN 16 726)
    - Service temperature: -10 °C min. to +40 °C max
    - Foldability at low temperature: Passed; No cracks at -25 °C (SN EN 495-5)
    - Watertightness: Pass (Method B, 24 h/10 bar) (EN 1928)
    - Water-vapour transmission rate: ~17 000 (SIA V280)
    - Chemical resistance: Pass (28 d / +23 °C); Pass (Method B, 24h / 60 kPa) (EN 1847) (EN 1928)
    - Behaviour after storage in warm water: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Resistance to weathering: Compliant (5000 hours) (SIA V280)
    - Thermal ageing: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Reaction to fire: Euroclass E (EN ISO 11925)
2.7 System structure. Refer to System Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec®
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1 roll of 30 m length; Refer to current price list for packaging variations
    - Shelf life: 36 months from date of production
2.9 Storage conditions. The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Opened and unprotected rolls must be used within 2 months. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: 1,6 mm
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
    - Reference must be made to the Sika® Application Manual: Sika® Dilatec® System.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Reference must be made to the Sika® Application Manual: Sika® Dilatec® System and System Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec®
4.5 Further information.
    - System Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec®
    - Sika® Application Manual: Sika® Dilatec®

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Refer to System Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec®
5.3 Substrate temperature. Refer to System Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec®
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Resistance to impact: ≥ 650 mm (SN EN 12691, method A)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Tensile strength: > 6,5 N/mm² (EN ISO 527-3)
    - Elongation: > 200 % (EN ISO 527-1)
    - Tear strength: Weld seam strength; Failure always adjacent to seam (DIN 16 726)
    - Seam strength: Weld seam strength: Failure always adjacent to seam (DIN 16 726)
    - Foldability at low temperature: Passed; No cracks at -25 °C (SN EN 495-5)
    - Watertightness: Pass (Method B, 24 h/10 bar) (EN 1928)
    - Water-vapour transmission rate: ~17 000 (SIA V280)
    - Chemical resistance: Pass (28 d / +23 °C); Pass (Method B, 24h / 60 kPa) (EN 1847) (EN 1928)
    - Behaviour after storage in warm water: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Resistance to weathering: Compliant (5000 hours) (SIA V280)
    - Thermal ageing: Compliant (SIA V280)
    - Reaction to fire: Euroclass E (EN ISO 11925)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Dilatec® BR-500, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sika-dilatec-br-500.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data and recommended uses for this product may vary from country to country. Consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data and uses.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
